environment.venv: python3 -m venv .venv-audio && .venv-audio/bin/pip install numpy==2.5.4 scipy==1.18.1 soundfile==0.14.0 matplotlib==3.11.2 (not committed)

beatGrid.note: beats at 0.5 + k*2/3 s; bars at 2.5 + m*8/3 s

instruments: felt piano (additive, inharmonic partials, velocity felt low-pass, two detuned strings, felt thump, damper)
bowed-string pad (3 detuned band-limited saws, slow vibrato, raised-cosine bow attack, low-pass 0.7–1.9 kHz, high-pass 110 Hz)
sine bass (sine + 2nd/3rd harmonic, soft attack; not under the #11 dark chord)
paper ticks (band-passed noise grains 2.4–7 kHz) on beats 2 and 4, bars 2–10 and #9 links only, pulled back while reading, skipped within 120 ms of an action SFX
convolution room (2.6 s decorrelated noise IR, low-passed 4.5 kHz)

sections.name: #1 brand
sections.music: sparse single felt-piano notes C5 · F4 (an eighth after the logo fold's paper flick, with the wordmark) · A4 · G4; pedal held to 4.0

sections.name: #2 entry
sections.music: open fifths F–C (4.0), D–A (5.17), Bb–F (6.50) over a soft bowed pad; RH A4, G4; C5 pickup at 7.50 into A

sections.name: A 研究白板
sections.music: broken-chord felt piano + sine bass on the 0.5 s-phase grid, paper ticks on beats 2/4 (pulled back while reading); chord changes on drop (7.83), ann-add (15.83), cards-new-claim (21.17), paint-apply (26.50); piano attacks kept off the click / toggle / pop / drop / snap frames (moved to the next eighth or tied over, see sfxFramesKeptClear)

sections.name: motif 思路
sections.music: upward pentatonic line C5 – D5 – F5 – G5 – A5 held, answering the right-click (cards-context) and rising over the typing; 20.833 · 21.833 · 22.167 · 22.500 · 22.833

sections.name: stop-time
sections.music: one beat: piano and bass damped, only the bowed pad (C7sus4) holds

sections.name: turn 1
sections.music: page turn (write-turn 32.0): only the bowed pad, Csus4 held, resolving to F as B starts

sections.name: B Markdown 笔记
sections.music: steady eighth-note felt-piano arpeggio (like writing), LH dyads + sine bass; chord changes 34.50, 37.17, links-insert 39.83, backlinks 42.50, 45.17; paper ticks only in #9 links; the arpeggio rests (ties over) on the first key, the pop and the two clicks

sections.name: #11 dark
sections.music: Bbmaj7 pad darkens (900 Hz); at dark-switch a low Dm9 (D2 A2 F3 C4 E4) on piano, high-passed at 90 Hz and 2 dB down (no sine-bass doubling: the D3–F3–C4–E4 upper voicing carries the darkening on small speakers), + dark pad (700 Hz)

sections.name: #12 files
sections.music: only long felt-piano notes: Bb2+F3 & D5 an eighth after the files-lift pop (50.83), C5 51.83, C3+G3 52.50, G4 53.17 (common tone into Fadd9)

sections.name: #13 end
sections.music: final Fadd9 (F2 C3 A3 F4 G4 C5) rolled on end-chord 54.167, piano + bass 3 dB under the first draft (it was the loudest moment, right after the quietest bar); pedal up 57.15; silent from ~58.2

music.mastering: high-pass 38 Hz (60 Hz on the piano bus, 90 Hz on the #11 dark chord), low shelf −3 dB @ 140 Hz, normalised to −17.5 LUFS, look-ahead limiter at −4.5 dBFS (peak-to-loudness 13 dB so mix_audio.py can normalise the film mix linearly)

cursor clicks the toolbar button
optional, not soundRequired: the two menu rows appear 4.40 / 4.60 (DIRECTION #2 两声极轻 pop)

release: the literature card lands (轻落声; the first product result, so a confirmation-depth duck): knock + 2–5 kHz contact, no piano attack under it
select the literature card
click 详细属性
click 查看批注 (the annotation dialog opens)
tick the first highlight
tick the second highlight
click 添加所选批注 + the quote cards land: both appear on the same frame, so one landing
right-click the quote card (context menu)
click 从这条批注新建观点 + the new claim card lands (DIRECTION #5 click + 轻落)
real typing in the new claim card (13 characters, 21.50–22.50)
click empty canvas: the claim is committed and its source footer shows
select the green source card
click 格式刷
brush lands on the target card (short brush, after the music's stop beat)
grab the reading-note card: friction while it follows the pointer, ends at the snap
the card jumps into alignment and the guide appears: light high tick, clearly over the music
page turn 1: crest at the turn start, fold rustle, settle at 32.70
real typing of the to-do line on its input schedule (src/notes/time.js TODO_UNITS): keys 33.50–33.87, pinyin bursts ending on each commit 34.00–34.80, Enter 34.90
typing the [[ query on its input schedule (src/notes/time.js LINK_UNITS)
the [[ picker pops up (short pop, 0.13 s)
click 常规条目
click the paper, link inserted
page turn 2 (dark → light): crest at the turn start, settle at 50.20
the two attachment rows lift (极轻 pop)
